title: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the right, left, bottom or top (a sheet), with title and footer.
when: Filters of a list, details of a row, a secondary form that keeps the page visible.
A sheet from the top (announcements, a global search) with side="top".

instead.need: A persistent tool panel beside a canvas

a11y: A modal dialog: focus trap, Escape, focus returns to the opener; the title labels it.
Autofocuses the first field on devices with a physical keyboard ((hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)) unless autoFocusFirstField={false}; touch phones keep the on-screen keyboard closed.
A title longer than 3 lines gets an expand button (aria-expanded, aria-controls the title). The scroll edges are aria-hidden.

examples.title: Sides
examples.description: side picks the edge: right (default), left, bottom (phone-style sheet) or top.

examples.title: Long title and long body
examples.description: The title wraps (3 lines, then a chevron); the body scrolls with a soft edge on the side where more content continues.
